subject: integration
name: Orivon payment sheet
summary: The browser's own payment sheet, opened by a page's payment request or a bitcoin: link. It plans routes over the facilitators the person has on, drops mismatched quotes, holds each signature to the quote's bounds, has the person confirm each, and ends a leg only on what the chain shows; it holds no funds or keys. Not level 4: it ranks routes by Web3 Scores nothing checks, asked of the person's score providers; payee code comes from the built-in light client. Quotes and reads come through the codes from the provider the person chose, judged on its own row. Judged here by its publisher.
